facts.fact: UNDP Togo states, on a visit of 27 May 2021, that the Kadodo application in the commune of Lacs 1 (Aného) records civil status acts, naming births, deaths and marriages, and gives the mayor a dashboard of statistics; it reports 1,975 births registered in 2020 against 700 in 2019.
UNDP Togo describes the Kadodo application as in use in one commune, Lacs 1, as of 27 May 2021; it gives no number of civil status centres in the commune and no national total.

UNDP Togo states that Kadodo was selected in a 2020 challenge run by its Accelerator Lab and that UNDP supplied the equipment and trained those involved in Lacs 1; no domestic budget line is mentioned.
